_note: English daily line. heads: one short line by the day's level (1 Low-key … 5 Excellent), three variants rotated by date. relations finish the 'why' sentence ("For a Candle like you, Wood is {relation}.") so they are noun phrases. tomorrow may use {theme} (e.g. "a Challenge Day") and {hour} (e.g. "1–3 PM").

relations.偏财: a surprise opportunity, maybe a windfall
relations.正官: the people who set the rules and give you credit
relations.七杀: the pressure that pushes you to step up
relations.正印: a helper who looks after you and recharges you
relations.偏印: the pull toward thinking things through more deeply
relations.比肩: a friend standing right beside you
relations.劫财: a rival competing for the same things
relations.食神: an easy, good mood that makes you want to create
relations.伤官: the urge to speak up and break the mold

5: Things are flowing today. Whatever you've been meaning to push, push it now.
A good day — don't hold back. If something needs saying, say it.
Full energy. A great day to make the call and close things out.
4: The wind is at your back. Go one step further today.
You can handle a lot today, so put what matters most first.
You're in good shape. Take the initiative and it will pay off.
3: An even day. Do what's in front of you well and you've won.
Go at your own pace. No need to force anything.
Stick to what's already on your plan — skip the impulse moves.
2: A day to hold back: finish what's in hand and save new things for tomorrow.
Speak a beat slower, and double-check anything important.
Don't get into a tug-of-war. Save your energy for your own things.
1: A day to slow down: stick to what you know and get to bed early.
If it can wait, let it wait. Look after yourself first.
Keep a low profile — no big calls, no arguments. Tomorrow is another day.

draw_hints.5: Your energy is flowing today too, so go after the good things this lot points to.
draw_hints.4: Today is going well overall. Take one step forward in the spirit of the lot.
draw_hints.3: An even day. Treat the lot as a reminder — no need to rush to conclusions.
draw_hints.2: Take care today. If the lot tells you to wait, wait a little.
draw_hints.1: Keep it low-key today. Look after yourself first; what the lot speaks of can wait.

Tomorrow flows — don't waste it. Tonight, list what you need to ask for or decide, and handle it first thing.
Full energy tomorrow. Get to bed early tonight and save your spark for {hour}.
4: Tomorrow is {theme}, with the wind at your back. Tonight, decide on the one step you'll take first.
You'll handle a lot tomorrow. Put what matters most around {hour}.
You'll be in good shape tomorrow. Get your materials ready tonight so nothing catches you off guard.
3: An even day tomorrow. Write a clear to-do list tonight, then just work through it.
Tomorrow is {theme}. Go at your own pace and put the important things at {hour}.
Tomorrow suits what's already on your plan. Don't add anything new tonight.
2: Take care tomorrow. Tonight, double-check anything you need to say or hand in.
Tomorrow is a day to hold back. Move important plans if you can; if not, prepare ahead.
Tomorrow could turn into a tug-of-war. Decide tonight where you're happy to give a little.
1: Keep it low-key tomorrow. Get to bed early and stick to familiar things.
Energy runs low tomorrow. Trim tomorrow's plans tonight and leave yourself some room.
